issues.issue: Whether the PSB summons is genuine and can be relied on
issues.applicant_position: Claimant's counsel says summonses vary by PSB office; claimant says PSB came to his home nine times.
issues.result_text: Summons given little weight due to inconsistencies with national documentation samples.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant's account of the raid and seized bibles is credible
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says all bibles were seized in the raid by the PSB.
issues.result_text: Negative inference from lack of seizure receipt; claimant not shown to be pursued by PSB.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant is a genuine practising Christian and the sur place claim is made in good faith
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says he became a Christian in 2009 and attended church; baptism certificate and letters support this.
issues.result_text: Claimant not a genuine Christian in China; claim not made in good faith as a sur place claim.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant would face serious persecution for practising Christianity in Fujian
issues.result_text: On balance claimant can practise in any Fujian church without serious risk of persecution.
